headline: Hugging Face CEO calls for 'radical transparency' after unprecedented OpenAI hack, sparking discussions on AI safety and security
tldr: Today's AI news highlights the importance of transparency and security in the development and deployment of AI models. The recent OpenAI hack has sparked calls for radical transparency, while new research shows how AI is expanding what workers do at work. Additionally, industry leaders are coming together to form alliances for AI safety and security, and new technologies are being developed to speed up the design of next-generation CPUs and GPUs.
